purpose: Separate prepaid Test service: first Smart admission for operator testing; not Alpha/public launch certification
rationale: Retain all twelve original cases and exact accepted answers. Require twelve fresh signed matches; no failed cases are removed or weakened.

Thirty seconds per network challenge is a provisional timeout, not a measured network SLA. The longest local answer was 956 ms; extra time accommodates worker polling, transport, signing and contention.
Use the existing reward formula with the catalog nominal 7B size and neutral coverage. No reward rate, funding, payout allocation or tariff is changed.
A configured policy applies to each signed provider advertising this exact Smart package on the separate Test service; it does not itself whitelist only the reporting wallet.
limits: One user-supplied unsigned run on one computer; no independent model-weight attestation, sustained performance proof, or broad quality/security certification.
The fixed public suite can be memorized; it is an operator pilot check, not Byzantine proof of useful inference.
No existing qualification is fabricated, imported, or renewed. Provider identity and fresh answers must pass the existing signed network protocol.
Purchase/payment readiness, account linking, free-credit funding and two-computer acceptance still require live checks.
Fast, Balanced and all other models remain without an automatic policy. No mainnet transfer or reward-cycle start is authorized by this review.
